summary.short: Amends China's Cybersecurity Law, effective 1 January 2026. Adds general principles and a provision on state support for AI research and infrastructure, adds personal-information processing duties, and revises penalties for network operators, critical information infrastructure operators, and product sellers, plus foreign actors harming cybersecurity.
summary.long: NPC Standing Committee decision adopted 28 October 2025, effective 1 January 2026, amending the Cybersecurity Law. It adds Art. 3 (Party leadership, overall national security concept, network power). New Art. 20 directs state support for AI basic research, key algorithms, training-data and computing infrastructure, AI ethics norms, risk monitoring and assessment, safety supervision, AI application, and AI use in cybersecurity management. New paragraph in Art. 42 requires network operators processing personal information to comply with the Cybersecurity Law, Civil Code and Personal Information Protection Law. Renumbers and rewrites the penalty provisions (Arts. 61-77): graded fines for breaching network security protection duties of network operators and critical information infrastructure operators; new Art. 63 penalising sale of uncertified critical network equipment and security products; Art. 67 fines of one to ten times procurement amount for critical infrastructure operators using unreviewed network products; higher fines for publishing prohibited information; cross-reference to other laws for personal information and cross-border data breaches; a mitigation clause (Art. 73); and Art. 77 liability and asset-freezing measures for overseas actors endangering China's cybersecurity.

notes: The decision amends the Cybersecurity Law article by article; provision IDs refer to the decision's item numbers and the new article numbers they set. Items 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 renumber and merge articles, so cross-references such as Art. 61(3) and Art. 64 follow the new numbering. Generic references to 有关主管部门 (competent authorities), 法律、行政法规 and 网络运营者 are not coded as named entities or relations. No internal inconsistency found. Effective date 1 January 2026 per the closing provision. The decision has no legal-basis clause. Section status below is required by the schema although entries are coded above.

thresholds.conditions: Applies to sale or provision of network critical equipment or dedicated cybersecurity products without security certification or testing, or with non-conforming certification or testing (violation of Art. 25 as inserted by item 七); unless other laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise.
